items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: It was a punk like him. It was Toodlam.

ctx.x: No. I want to hear a bad man about it. I want to see if you want to talk about Aaron Harris. Yeah, well, it's not one of you. Yeah, this is Aaron. That was a bad boy. Did you?

I knew him. Yeah. You knew him too, huh? Oh, yeah, I knew him. What do you think they're talking about? It was a punk like him. It was Toodlam. It was Aaron Harris. It was Frenchy. Oh, it was Johnny Ray. It was Tom Leon. I mean, these were bad boys. You see, when the cop wanted Aaron, they wouldn't take him up like they'd pick up nobody. They'd tell him the chief want to see him. Yeah. I'll be there tomorrow, tell him. They tricked him out of his life. You see, uh... Yeah, they tricked him out of his life. If…
That'd be a gentleman to make it. Yeah, the gentleman, I see.
